faq.q1: What is the accuracy of AI metadata generation?

legal.termsContent:
1. Parties and Scope

These Terms of Use govern the relationship between MayaListing (the "Platform") and the people who use it ("User"). The Platform is a software service that analyzes images with AI and suggests titles, descriptions, keywords and tags for stock photo sites and e-commerce marketplaces. You must be at least 18 years old to use it.

2. Plans, Limits and Payment

The Platform offers Free, Starter, Pro and Studio plans. Each plan's monthly analyses are shown on the pricing page; unused analyses do not roll over. To prevent abuse, daily fair-use limits apply (60 analyses per day on Starter, 150 on Pro, 100 on Studio), and analyses from the same network on the Free plan may be limited. Your email address must be confirmed before you can run analyses. Paid plans are sold and charged by Lemon Squeezy as the Merchant of Record; invoices, refunds and withdrawal requests are handled under Lemon Squeezy's terms and applicable consumer law. You can cancel your subscription on the Billing page; cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period.

3. Acceptable Use

Only upload images you have the right to use. Uploading unlawful images, images that infringe others' rights or contain their personal data without permission, overloading the Platform with automated tools, trying to bypass limits, opening multiple accounts to abuse free allowances or trying to break its security is prohibited and may lead to suspension or closure of your account.

4. Intellectual Property

The Platform's software, design and content belong to MayaListing and may not be copied, modified or reverse engineered. All rights to the images you upload remain yours. You may use the titles, descriptions and keywords generated from your images as you wish.

5. AI Output and Liability

Generated metadata consists of AI suggestions and may contain mistakes; review it before uploading. MayaListing does not guarantee its accuracy, acceptance by stock platforms or any sales result. Except where liability cannot be limited by law, MayaListing's liability is limited to the amount you paid for the service in the last twelve months.

6. Ending Your Account

You can delete your account at any time on the Account page; this permanently deletes your history and images. MayaListing may suspend or close accounts that breach these Terms.

7. Changes

Significant changes to these Terms are announced on the Platform and to your registered email address at least 30 days before they take effect. If you do not accept them, you can cancel your subscription or delete your account before that date.

8. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Turkey. Consumers' rights to apply to consumer arbitration committees and consumer courts are reserved.
legal.privacyContent:
1. Scope and Controller

This Privacy Policy explains how personal data is processed through the mayalisting.com website and app (the "Platform"). The data controller is MayaListing. Details under Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK") are in the KVKK Notice. Contact: destek.mayalisting@gmail.com

2. What We Process

  • Account data: name and email address. Your password is stored only as an irreversible hash; we cannot see it. If you sign in with Google, we use the name and email address Google shares with us.
  • Images you upload and generated content: the images you upload for analysis and the titles, descriptions, keywords and file names generated from them. If an image shows a person's face or other personal data, that data is processed too; only upload images of other people if you have the necessary permission.
  • Usage and subscription data: plan, usage counts, renewal and subscription status, activity history.
  • Payment data: your card details never reach us; Lemon Squeezy takes the payment as the seller. We only receive the subscription status, a customer number and your email address.
  • Technical and security data: IP address, browser details and server logs. The IP address is also used in daily usage counters to prevent abuse and overload.
  • Support correspondence: the content of emails you send us.
  • Cookies and similar data: see section 4.

3. Why We Use It

To create your account and keep you signed in, analyze your images and generate metadata, show your analysis history, manage your subscription and usage limits, prevent abuse and security risks, answer support requests, meet legal obligations and, only with your consent, measure site usage and the effectiveness of our ads.

4. Cookies and Browser Storage

Essential cookies and browser storage keep you signed in, remember your language and theme and store your cookie choice; the service needs them to work. Google Analytics and Google Ads cookies are enabled only if you accept them in the cookie notice; if you decline, these tools do not use cookies. You can change your choice at any time with the "Cookie Preferences" link at the bottom of the page.

5. How Your Images Are Processed

Images are processed only to generate metadata for you. They are not sold, not used for advertising and not used by us to train any AI model. For analysis, a downscaled copy is sent to the Google Gemini API; under Google's paid API terms, Google does not use this content to train its models. The downscaled copy is kept in a private store only you can access, to show in your analysis history.

6. Service Providers and International Transfers

We work with the following providers, which process data on our behalf and on our instructions:

  • Supabase (database, sign-in, image storage): servers in the European Union (Frankfurt).
  • Vercel (website and server hosting): server logs and IP addresses.
  • Google (Gemini AI analysis, Google sign-in, support email; Analytics and Ads only with consent).
  • Lemon Squeezy (payments and subscriptions, acting as the seller of record).

Some of these providers process data outside Turkey, in particular in the European Union and the United States. International transfers are made with the safeguards required by Article 9 of the KVKK and, for users in the European Economic Area, by the GDPR (such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses). Apart from lawful requests by competent authorities, your data is not shared with anyone else.

7. Automatic Replies to Support Emails

The first reply to emails sent to our support address may be prepared automatically by processing your email with Google Gemini. Automatic replies are for information only; refund, billing and technical matters are also reviewed by a person.

8. Retention

  • Account data, analysis history and images: until you delete them or delete your account.
  • Daily usage counters tied to IP addresses: at most 30 days.
  • Payment and invoice records: for the period required by tax law.
  • Server logs and support correspondence: as long as needed for that purpose.

9. Your Rights and Deleting Your Data

Your rights under Article 11 of the KVKK are listed in the KVKK Notice. You can permanently delete your account, analysis history and images at any time with "Delete Account" on the Account page; any paid subscription is cancelled. You can delete a single analysis from the history page. Users in the European Economic Area can also exercise their GDPR rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection, and lodge a complaint with their local supervisory authority.

10. Security

Data is encrypted in transit (TLS). Images are kept in a private store and shown only to their owner through time-limited links. In the database, each user can access only their own records.

11. Children

The Platform is not intended for anyone under 18.

12. Changes

When we update this policy we show the effective date on this page, and we also email you about significant changes.
legal.kvkkContent:
This Notice is provided under Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK") and the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles for Fulfilling the Obligation to Inform.

1. Data Controller

The data controller is MayaListing (mayalisting.com). Contact: destek.mayalisting@gmail.com

2. Categories of Personal Data

  • Identity: first and last name.
  • Contact: email address.
  • Customer transactions: plan, usage counts, analysis history, subscription status, support correspondence.
  • Images and content: images you upload (including any personal data they contain) and the generated titles, descriptions, keywords and file names.
  • Transaction security: IP address, session and sign-in records, hashed password.
  • Marketing: only with your explicit consent, usage data collected through Google Analytics and Google Ads cookies.

We do not process your card details; payments are taken by Lemon Squeezy.

3. Purposes and Legal Grounds

  • Creating your account, providing the service (image analysis and metadata generation), keeping your history, managing your subscription and usage limits: necessary for entering into and performing a contract (KVKK Art. 5/2-c).
  • Keeping invoice and accounting records and answering requests of competent authorities: compliance with a legal obligation (Art. 5/2-ç).
  • Information security, preventing abuse and overload (including IP-based daily limits), answering support requests and improving the service: legitimate interest (Art. 5/2-f).
  • Measuring site usage and ad effectiveness (Google Analytics / Google Ads): explicit consent (Art. 5/1). You give it in the cookie notice and can withdraw it at any time with "Cookie Preferences".

4. How Data Is Collected

Through sign-up and sign-in forms, Google sign-in, image uploads, your actions in the app, subscription notifications from the payment provider, support emails and cookies, electronically and by partly or fully automated means.

5. Transfers and International Transfers

For the purposes above only, data is transferred to these suppliers: Supabase (database, authentication and image storage; servers in the European Union), Vercel (hosting), Google (Gemini AI analysis, Google sign-in, email; Analytics and Ads only with your explicit consent) and Lemon Squeezy (payments and subscriptions). These suppliers may process data outside Turkey, in the European Union and the United States; international transfers follow the procedures and safeguards of Article 9 of the KVKK. Data may also be disclosed to competent public authorities on request, as required by law.

6. Retention

Personal data is kept as long as the purpose requires and as required by law: account, history and images until you delete them or your account; IP-based daily counters for at most 30 days; invoice and payment records for the period required by tax law. Afterwards the data is deleted, destroyed or anonymized.

7. Your Rights under Article 11 of the KVKK

By applying to the data controller, you can:

  • Learn whether your personal data is processed,
  • Request information about it if it is,
  • Learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used accordingly,
  • Know the third parties in Turkey or abroad to whom it is transferred,
  • Request correction if it is incomplete or inaccurate,
  • Request deletion or destruction under the conditions of Article 7 of the KVKK,
  • Request that corrections, deletions or destructions be notified to third parties to whom the data was transferred,
  • Object to a result against you that arises from analysis exclusively by automated systems,
  • Claim compensation for damage caused by unlawful processing.

8. How to Apply

Send your request in writing from the email address registered on the Platform to destek.mayalisting@gmail.com, in line with the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles of Applications to the Data Controller. Include your name, contact details and the subject of your request. Requests are answered free of charge within thirty days at the latest. You can also delete your account and data directly with "Delete Account" on the Account page.
